clauses.text:
Executive Orber.
Mr. Philip WV. Reinhard, Jr., of New York, confidential clerk to the
Collector of Customs at New York, may be transferred from the excepted
to the competitive class because of his faithful service duv'ing the past
nine years, it being desirable that he continue in the performance of the
responsible duties, classified in character, which he has been per forming.
THEODORE ROOSEVELT
TILE WHITE HOUSE,
Maierc/i 6, 1908.
[NO. 768.!:
